question: What should come in the place of blank number (1)?
solution:
The correct answer is '**colonized**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the shift of human agency and subjectivity under the influence of algorithmic systems and digital infrastructure.
 
• The appropriate word should indicate an invasive takeover or total shaping of the internal self by external "ambient infrastructures."
 
• "**Colonized**" fits well as it denotes an external power taking control of a territory (in this case, human subjectivity), aligning with the idea that our internal states are being pre-empted and molded.
 
• Other options ("**foreclosed**", "**automated**", "**mediated**") either fail to capture the invasive nature of the change or are too weak to describe the "paradigmatic mutation" mentioned.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *In the contemporary epoch of algorithmic governance and hyper-networked economies, the discourse of agency has undergone a paradigmatic mutation. No longer anchored in traditional notions of volition or deliberation, subjectivity is increasingly 1. **colonized**__ by ambient infrastructures that anticipate, nudge, and pre-empt decision-making before cognition consolidates intention. In such a regime, autonomy becomes retroactive—a post-facto narrative stitched together by feedback loops of personalization, predictive modeling, and biometric calibration. The liberal ideal of the rational actor, so central to modern jurisprudence and economic theory, finds itself *

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Foreclosed (वर्जित/निरुद्ध): Means to rule out or prevent something from happening; while the systems prevent traditional agency, they more accurately "occupy" subjectivity.
 
• Automated (स्वचालित): Suggests something becoming mechanical; while relevant, it refers more to the process than the loss of sovereignty described here.
 
• Mediated (मध्यस्थता): Means to act as an intermediary; this is too neutral a term for the aggressive "nudge and pre-empt" tactics described in the text.
